title: Chapter 72 — Scaling the Book: Capacity and The Ceiling
intro: The honest ceiling, leverage systems, and the trade team.

sections.title: Know Your Ceiling
sections.content:
Every individual trade specialist has a capacity ceiling — the point where adding more accounts means service quality declines. Know your ceiling. When you hit it, the answer is not to work harder. It is to build systems and potentially a team.

Leverage tools — CRM automation, quoting templates, standard programs — extend your capacity before you need additional people.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating scaling, ask:

Does the salesperson know their capacity ceiling?
Are they using leverage tools to extend capacity?
When capacity is reached, is there a plan for growth — or just stress?
